title: Stand where fear cannot rule
summary: Reverence gives the heart another center besides fear. Return the breath before fear chooses the story.
takeaway: Return the breath before fear chooses the story.
lifeApplication: Before the next defensive move, bring the breath back under one line of refuge and mercy.

source.shortMeaning: Reverence gives the heart another center besides fear.
source.lifeApplication: When fear starts ruling the body, stand still long enough to remember what holds you.

evidence.coreClaim: Reverence gives the heart another center besides fear.
evidence.turn: Keep this in front of you: call for shelter before fear becomes your only voice.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before the next defensive move, bring the breath back under one line of refuge and mercy.
